verdict.rationale: Self-hosting and full data export/import tools give organizations control over where data lives and how it can be migrated or removed from Zulip Cloud (zulip-docs-6, zulip-docs-8, zulip-docs-10, zulip-docs-14), which indirectly supports data retention/deletion control, but there is no documentation of message retention policies, deletion APIs, or per-user/tenant deletion guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit retention policy settings, message/account deletion controls, and any AI-specific data handling or deletion guarantees.
